messages:
Marco: Hey team — quick question. I finished the year with 12h PTO unused. Policy says 8h carryover max into Jan. Can we do 8h carryover + pay out 4h or another option? My manager Leah is in EMEA and out late-night but responsive.
Leah: Hi Marco, saw this. I can approve the 8h carryover. For the remaining 4h we usually do either payout or convert to unpaid/float depending on local law. Which do you prefer?
Marco: Payout would be best. Also note I had two half-day sick uses in Nov; nothing medical documented.
Nina (People Ops): Quick run-down: company default = 8h carryover cap. Exceptions possible when there are extenuating circumstances (medical or approved business continuity). Payouts require payroll cutoffs; conversions to unpaid require manager + People Ops sign-off.
Marco: Is there a form? I can submit anything needed.
Nina: Yes — submit CE-2099 (carryover/payout combo) at https://redwood.company/hr/pto-exception and attach manager approval. Since this is a non-medical carryover >8h we need manager note + People Ops review. Payroll cutoff for year-end run is 2026-01-04 18:00 UTC.
Leah: I approve 8h carryover and payout 4h for Marco. Approving now in BambooHR.
BambooHR Bot: Manager approval recorded: Leah approved carryover 8h + payout 4h for Marco on 2025-12-29 09:12 UTC.
Marco: Submitted CE-2099 with reason "year-end overflow; manager approved" and attached Leah's BambooHR approval screenshot.
Nina: Received CE-2099. Note: non-medical exceptions are discretionary; Payroll will confirm if payout processed this cycle or deferred to next run due to cutoff. We'll triage now.
Payroll Bot: CE-2099 acknowledged. Two possible outcomes: (1) Payout processed in current run if paperwork and approvals complete before cutoff 2026-01-04 18:00 UTC, (2) otherwise payout scheduled to next payroll (may affect tax withholding). Payroll will post a confirmation message here once processed.
Marco: Also, is it possible to split the 8h carryover into 4h PTO + 4h "wellness bank" to use for flexible sick?
Nina: Policy doesn't support ad-hoc reclassification unless HR policy update. We can consider temporarily converting to paid sick only with medical documentation. Otherwise keep as PTO carryover. If you want to request reclassification, file DOC-3499 (policy review) and we'll route to Legal/Benefits.
Leah: For clarity I ran the /pto command for Marco so system shows pending items: ```/pto adjust --user @Marco --carryover 8h --payout 4h --note "manager approved"```
People Ops Bot: Action logged: CE-2099 received; BambooHR approval present; pending payroll confirmation. Requested docs: none (non-medical). Ticket DOC-3499 opened for policy reclassification review.
Marco: Thanks — appreciate the speed. One more: will payout affect my year-end bonus calc?
Nina: Payout is part of taxable wages; it does not reduce bonus eligibility. If comp has special rules we'll flag payroll to check with Finance.
Payroll Bot: Confirmed: Processing queue updated. If CE-2099 clears before cutoff we'll include 4h payout in next deposit (pay period end 2026-01-15). If delayed, payout moves to subsequent cycle.
Leah: Thanks team — leaving this here until Payroll confirms.
People Ops Bot: Thread status: awaiting payroll finalization. Will post an update when complete.
